findings.title: 学习、参数语义、项目迁移和验收混为一个视频分母
findings.mechanism: LearningCoverage takes all assessed title parts/qualifications plus confirmed concepts, without a target-kind distinction. Some are real prerequisite skills; others are application choices or acceptance conditions. 0/N is exact requirement-source-fit, not a measure of useful transferable learning.
examples: Data k3: end<start、相等边界与to_datetime(errors)并列
Arduino k4: random(2000,5001)项目数值与millis/非阻塞技能并列
Data k7: 文件名约定、输出检查与CSV写出技能并列
findings.do_not_infer: All exact parameters are practice-only; errors semantics and random parameter bounds may themselves need teaching.

findings.title: 补充API核心只留在卡片理由，路线无法表达其有限学习价值
findings.mechanism: Expected IDs come only from collection goals. Supplemental api_operation_core rows are filtered before route generation, so title-bound introductory clues never appear in the learning-route panel. This is correct for the old precise-target denominator, but poor as a complete learning-support summary.
findings.correct_fix: Separate a clearly weak introductory-clue lane. Do not count title-only core as own-body/catalog support or fill exact parameters.

findings.title: 卡片相关性与路线内容证据两种合同缺少近邻说明
findings.mechanism: topicEvidence accepts search/page/catalog for partial card relatedness while LearningCoverage accepts only own body/catalog or strictly bound video summary. Current partly-matching card can say existing source evidence while route says0/N. The r9 wording narrowed the claim but did not explain evidence levels.
findings.correct_fix: Use distinct labels for verified video identity, title-related introductory clue, own-body/catalog teaching support and unverified project application.

findings.title: 仍需补充与下一步把迁移练习也引向继续找视频
findings.mechanism: The firstUrl+missing branch always seeks videos/materials for every missing row. Business values, file naming or project-specific acceptance should normally direct the learner to apply/verify after acquiring the skill, without assuming a video contains the same project.
findings.constraint: Missing underlying boolean logic, API parameter semantics or state-machine knowledge remains a real learning gap.

findings.title: 宽窄不同且重叠的行被扁平计数，分母不能视作教学完成度
findings.mechanism: whole_topic/title fragments/operation_core/operation_qualification/confirmed concepts have different granularity. Exact-text dedup removes only identical text. Distinct phrases can be legitimately related but not safely auto-merged.
findings.correct_fix: Use typed stable transferable learning goals and hierarchy; retain all original requirement IDs in a separate checklist. Do not fuzzy-merge or invent semantic support.

findings.title: 跨角色同文AND合并不能跨学习支持与学生实践状态
findings.mechanism: coverageDisplay deliberately keeps a merged same-text group unknown if any member is unknown. This is safe for the current single evidence axis; once learning and application are separated it must group only within the same axis, otherwise unknown practice can erase valid skill support.
findings.correct_fix: Keep exact text/all IDs and strict same-axis evidence binding; never borrow support across axes.

findings.title: 旧0full不能推出没有任何有用教学，也不能靠改分母宣布生产通过
findings.mechanism: final-content-gaps correctly reports old project-target/body-catalog contract, but the denominator includes project behavior and confirmed parameters. It is not an independent measure of transferable teaching usefulness or learner practice completion.
findings.correct_fix: Keep old records unchanged; publish separate evidence-level learning-support, unresolved learning-needs and student application/acceptance outcomes, with a newly reviewed rubric.
